arxiv-2002-08203.title: On Computability of Data Word Functions Defined by Transducers
arxiv-2002-08203.creator: Léo Exibard, Emmanuel Filiot, Pierre-Alain Reynier
arxiv-2002-08203.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the problem of synthesizing computable functions of infinite words over an infinite alphabet (data ω \omega -words). The notion of computability is defined through Turing machines with infinite inputs which can produce the corresponding infinite outputs in the limit.

arxiv-2105-13436.title: Minimal extensions of Tannakian categories in positive characteristic
arxiv-2105-13436.creator: Shlomo Gelaki
arxiv-2105-13436.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shlomo Gelaki. We extend [ DGNO1 , Theorem 4.5] and [ LKW , Theorem 4.22] to positive characteristic (i.e., to the finite, not necessarily fusion, case). arxiv-2110-03581.title: Properties of mixing BV vector fields
arxiv-2110-03581.creator: Stefano Bianchini, Martina Zizza
arxiv-2110-03581.description: Abstract We consider the density properties of divergence-free vector fields b ∈ L 1 ​ ( [ 0 , 1 ] , BV ⁡ ( [ 0 , 1 ] 2 ) ) b\in L^{1}([0,1],\BV([0,1]^{2})) which are ergodic/weakly mixing/strongly mixing: this means that their Regular Lagrangian Flow X t X_{t} is an ergodic/weakly mixing/strongly mixing measure preserving map when evaluated

arxiv-2112-11409.title: Waveform-Defined Privacy: A Signal Solution to Protect Wireless Sensing
arxiv-2112-11409.creator: Tongyang Xu
arxiv-2112-11409.description: Abstract Wireless signals are commonly used for communications. Emerging applications are giving new functions to wireless signals, in which wireless sensing is the most attractive one. Channel state information (CSI) is not only the parameter for channel equalization in communications but also the indicator for wireless sensing.

arxiv-2305-11704.title: Comment on “Atomic structure and electron impact excitation of Al-like ions (Ga–Br)" by HB Wang and G Jiang in At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 148 (2022) 101532 Journal: Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables
arxiv-2305-11704.creator: Kanti M. Aggarwal, Ken W. Smith
arxiv-2305-11704.description: Abstract In a recent paper, Wang and Jiang (At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 148 (2022) 101532) have reported data for energy levels, radiative rates (A-values), and effective collision strengths ( Υ \Upsilon ) for some transitions of five Al-like ions, namely Ga XIX, Ge XX, As XXI, Se XXII, and Br XXIII.

arxiv-2305-15689.title: Zero-shot Approach to Overcome Perturbation Sensitivity of Prompts
arxiv-2305-15689.creator: Mohna Chakraborty, Adithya Kulkarni *, Qi Li
arxiv-2305-15689.description: Abstract Recent studies have demonstrated that natural-language prompts can help to leverage the knowledge learned by pre-trained language models for the binary sentence-level sentiment classification task. Specifically, these methods utilize few-shot learning settings to fine-tune the sentiment classification model using manual or automatically generated prompts. However, the performance of these methods is sensitive to the perturbations of the utilized prompts.

arxiv-2404-12189.title: Helicity oscillations in Rayleigh-Bénard convection of liquid metal in a cell with aspect ratio 0.5
arxiv-2404-12189.creator: Rahul Mitra, Frank Stefani, Vladimir Galindo, Sven Eckert, Max Sieger, Tobias Vogt, Thomas Wondrak
arxiv-2404-12189.description: Abstract In this paper, we present numerical and experimental results on helicity oscillations in a liquid-metal Rayleigh-Bénard (RB) convection cell, with an aspect ratio of 0.5 0.5 . We find that helicity oscillations occur during transitions of flow states that are characterised by significant changes in the Reynolds number.

arxiv-2404-19315.title: Modeling Orthographic Variation in Occitan’s Dialects
arxiv-2404-19315.creator: Zachary William Hopton, Noëmi Aepli
arxiv-2404-19315.description: Abstract Effectively normalizing textual data poses a considerable challenge, especially for low-resource languages lacking standardized writing systems. In this study, we fine-tuned a multilingual model with data from several Occitan dialects and conducted a series of experiments to assess the model’s representations of these dialects. For evaluation purposes, we compiled a parallel lexicon encompassing four Occitan dialects.

arxiv-2412-01786.title: Gradient-Free Generation for Hard-Constrained Systems
arxiv-2412-01786.creator: Chaoran Cheng, Boran Han, Danielle C. Maddix, Abdul Fatir Ansari, Andrew Stuart, Michael W. Mahoney, Yuyang Wang
arxiv-2412-01786.description: Abstract Generative models that satisfy hard constraints are critical in many scientific and engineering applications, where physical laws or system requirements must be strictly respected. Many existing constrained generative models, especially those developed for computer vision, rely heavily on gradient information, which is often sparse or computationally expensive in some fields, e.g., partial differential equations (PDEs).

arxiv-2412-20365.title: Accelerated Regularized Learning in Finite N N -Person Games
arxiv-2412-20365.creator: Kyriakos Lotidis c,∗, Angeliki Giannou ⋄, Panayotis Mertikopoulos ♯, Nicholas Bambos ∗
arxiv-2412-20365.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kyriakos Lotidis c,∗, Angeliki Giannou ⋄, Panayotis Mertikopoulos ♯, Nicholas Bambos ∗. Motivated by the success of Nesterov’s accelerated gradient algorithm for convex minimization problems, we examine whether it is possible to achieve similar performance gains in the context of online learning in games.

arxiv-2508-17437.title: Pixie: Fast and Generalizable Supervised Learning of 3D Physics from Pixels
arxiv-2508-17437.creator: Long Le Ryan Lucas Chen Wang Chuhao Chen, [2pt] Dinesh Jayaraman Eric Eaton Lingjie Liu, [2pt] University of Pennsylvania
arxiv-2508-17437.description: Abstract Inferring the physical properties of 3D scenes from visual information is a critical yet challenging task for creating interactive and realistic virtual worlds. While humans intuitively grasp material characteristics such as elasticity or stiffness, existing methods often rely on slow, per-scene optimization, limiting their generalizability and application.

arxiv-2602-08379.title: Heavy quark collisional energy loss in a nonextensive quark-gluon plasma
arxiv-2602-08379.creator: Bing-feng Jiang, Jun Chen, De-fu Hou
arxiv-2602-08379.description: Abstract In this study, we derive the longitudinal and transverse gluon self-energies and the corresponding dielectric functions for a nonextensive QGP, based on nonextensive statistical mechanics and a kinetic theory framework. The nonextensive parameter q q enters these quantities primarily through the modification of the Debye mass.

arxiv-2604-05873.creator: Chen Su, Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song ∗

pmc-10547306.title: Arginine Vasopressin Plays a Role in Microvascular Dysfunction After ST‐Elevation Myocardial Infarction
pmc-10547306.creator: Ayman Al‐Atta, Luke Spray, Ashfaq Mohammed, Evgeniya Shmeleva, Ioakim Spyridopoulos
pmc-10547306.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundCoronary microvascular dysfunction (CMD) predicts mortality after ST‐elevation–myocardial infarction (STEMI). Arginine vasopressin (AVP) may be implicated, but data in humans are lacking, and no study has investigated the link between arginine vasopressin and invasive measures of CMD.Methods and ResultsWe invasively assessed CMD in 55 patients with STEMI treated with primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PPCI), by measuring the index of microcirculatory resistance after PPCI.

pmc-10564921.title: The future landscape of large language models in medicine
pmc-10564921.creator: Jan Clusmann, Fiona R. Kolbinger, Hannah Sophie Muti, Zunamys I. Carrero, Jan-Niklas Eckardt, Narmin Ghaffari Laleh, Chiara Maria Lavinia Löffler, Sophie-Caroline Schwarzkopf, Michaela Unger, Gregory P. Veldhuizen, Sophia J. Wagner, Jakob Nikolas Kather
pmc-10564921.description: Large language models (LLMs) are artificial intelligence (AI) tools specifically trained to process and generate text. LLMs attracted substantial public attention after OpenAI’s ChatGPT was made publicly available in November 2022. LLMs can often answer questions, summarize, paraphrase and translate text on a level that is nearly indistinguishable from human capabilities.

pmc-10623886.title: AKT1 induces Nanog promoter in a SUMOylation-dependent manner in different pluripotent contexts
pmc-10623886.creator: Marcos Gabriel Francia, Paula Verneri, Camila Oses, Camila Vazquez Echegaray, Mora Reneé Garcia, Ayelen Toro, Valeria Levi, Alejandra Sonia Guberman
pmc-10623886.description: AKT/PKB is a kinase crucial for pluripotency maintenance in pluripotent stem cells. Multiple post-translational modifications modulate its activity. We have previously demonstrated that AKT1 induces the expression of the pluripotency transcription factor Nanog in a SUMOylation-dependent manner in mouse embryonic stem cells. Here, we studied different cellular contexts and main candidates that could mediate this induction.

pmc-10636479.title: Robotic-assisted wire saw resection of high-position rib tumors: a single-center experience
pmc-10636479.creator: Hao Peng, Maierhaba Maitiyasen, Siqi Sheng, Jingfeng Li, Yuxuan Liu, Jing Chen, Haizhu Song, Jun Yi
pmc-10636479.description: BackgroundRib tumors are typically curable through rib resection, associated with an excellent prognosis. Although transthoracic robotic first rib resection for thoracic outlet syndrome (TOS) has been previously documented, this paper presents our experience and technique in conducting robotic-assisted wire saw resections for high-position rib tumors.

pmc-10670381.title: Modelling and Research on Intuitionistic Fuzzy Goal-Based Attack and Defence Game for Infrastructure Networks
pmc-10670381.creator: Zhe Li, Jin Liu, Yibo Dong, Jiaqi Ren, Weili Li
pmc-10670381.description: Network attack and defence games are gradually becoming a new approach through which to study the protection of infrastructure networks such as power grids and transportation networks. Uncertainty factors, such as the subjective decision preferences of attackers and defenders, are not considered in existing attack and defence game studies for infrastructure networks.

pmc-10747025.title: Chemical Profile of Essential Oils of Selected Lamiaceae Plants and In Vitro Activity for Varroosis Control in Honeybees (Apis mellifera)
pmc-10747025.creator: Roberto Bava, Fabio Castagna, Carmine Lupia, Stefano Ruga, Vincenzo Musella, Filomena Conforti, Mariangela Marrelli, Maria Pia Argentieri, Domenico Britti, Giancarlo Statti, Ernesto Palma
pmc-10747025.description: Simple SummaryVarroa destructor acariasis is currently the main threat to the health and survival of honeybee colonies. Chemicals are often used to control this parasitosis. However, overuse and misuse over the years has allowed the mite to acquire resistance to synthetic active ingredients. In this scenario, it is vital to search for alternative therapeutic solutions.

pmc-11320856.title: 18F-FDG PET can effectively rule out conversion to dementia and the presence of CSF biomarker of neurodegeneration: a real-world data analysis
pmc-11320856.creator: Sébastien Heyer, Maïa Simon, Matthieu Doyen, Ali Mortada, Véronique Roch, Elodie Jeanbert, Nathalie Thilly, Catherine Malaplate, Anna Kearney-Schwartz, Thérèse Jonveaux, Aurélie Bannay, Antoine Verger
pmc-11320856.description: BackgroundPrecisely defining the delay in onset of dementia is a particular challenge for early diagnosis. Brain [18F] fluoro-2-deoxy-2-D-glucose (18F-FDG) Positron Emission Tomography (PET) is a particularly interesting tool for the early diagnosis of neurodegenerative diseases, through the measurement of the cerebral glucose metabolic rate.

pmc-11349956.title: DESI-TQ-MS imaging for ex vivo brain biodistribution assessment: evaluation of LBT-999, a ligand of the dopamine transporter (DAT)
pmc-11349956.creator: Laurent Galineau, Emmanuelle Claude, Zuhal Gulhan, Sylvie Bodard, Sophie Sérrière, Camille Dupuy, Jérémy Monteiro, Adeline Oury, Priscila Bertevello, Gabrielle Chicheri, Johnny Vercouillie, Lydie Nadal-Desbarats, Sylvie Chalon, Antoine Lefèvre, Patrick Emond
pmc-11349956.description: BackgroundSelection of the most promising radiotracer candidates for radiolabeling is a difficult step in the development of radiotracer pharmaceuticals, especially for the brain. Mass spectrometry (MS) is an alternative to study ex vivo the characteristics of candidates, but most MS studies are complicated by the pharmacologic doses injected and the dissection of regions to study candidate biodistribution.

pmc-11449405.title: Safety of low-intensity extracorporeal shock wave therapy in prostate disorders: in vitro and in vivo evidence
pmc-11449405.creator: Yi-Ran Wang, Bin Feng, Wen-Bo Qi, Yu-Wen Gong, Xiang-Bin Kong, Hui Cheng, Zhi-Long Dong, Jun-Qiang Tian, Zhi-Ping Wang
pmc-11449405.description: Recent evidence suggests that low-intensity extracorporeal shock wave therapy (Li-ESWT) is a promising treatment for chronic prostatitis/chronic pelvic pain syndrome (CP/CPPS); however, its safety in pelvic organs, particularly prostate tissues and cells, remains unclear. The current study evaluates the risks of prostate cell damage or oncogenesis following the administration of Li-ESWT for prostatitis.

pmc-11608080.title: Comparative Efficacy of Novel Versus Traditional Antiemetic Agents in Preventing Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting With Moderate or Highly Emetogenic Chemotherapy: A Systematic Review
pmc-11608080.creator: Sally M Nashed, Rami Kamal A Morcos, Muhammad Atif, Abdullah Shehryar, Abdur Rehman, Reema Kumari, Safiyyah M Khan, Waleed Hassan, Muhammad Roshan Zeb, Talha A Zia, Syed Jameel
pmc-11608080.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This systematic review critically evaluates the comparative efficacy of novel and traditional antiemetic agents in preventing chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV) in patients receiving moderate or highly emetogenic chemotherapy (MEC/HEC). The findings suggest that novel agents, such as netupitant/palonosetron (NEPA), olanzapine, and transdermal granisetron (GTDS), offer comparable or superior efficacy to traditional antiemetic regimens, including standard options like aprepitant combined with 5-HT₃ receptor antagonists and corticosteroids.

pmc-12638578.title: Sex-specific performance of clinical diagnostic algorithms for HFpEF across two independent cohorts
pmc-12638578.creator: Xinyu Li, Anouk Achten, Soufiane Nassiri, Sanne Mourmans, Arno A van de Bovenkamp, Christian Knackstedt, M Louis Handoko, Jerremy Weerts, Vanessa van Empel
pmc-12638578.description: BackgroundDiagnosing heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) remains challenging. While diagnostic algorithms support clinical evaluation, their performance across sexes is understudied, despite HFpEF being more prevalent in females, which may result in sex-specific underdiagnosis.PurposeTo assess the diagnostic accuracy of three HFpEF algorithms—HFA-PEFF, H2FPEF, and the ESC HF 2016 criteria—and to evaluate sex-related differences in performance.

pmc-13193623.title: Genomic and transcriptomic insights into Achromobacter–Sphingobium co-colonization within polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon-exposed bacterial communities
pmc-13193623.creator: Mana Sato, Robert A Kanaly, Jiro F Mori
pmc-13193623.description: Efficient and complete biodegradation of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), which are persistent and genotoxic petroleum hydrocarbon pollutants, is often considered to require the cooperative activities of multiple bacterial groups, and bacterial (meta)genomic investigations of PAH-exposed ecosystems have contributed to elucidating such interactions.

pmc-13224448.title: Lower limb amputation by emergency medical technicians: a case report from scene
pmc-13224448.creator: Vahid Ghanbari, Abbas Maleki, Esmaeil Ghadimi, Kiarash Naderi Moghaddam, Leili Rostamnia, Ali Ghanbari Rafatie
pmc-13224448.description: BackgroundAgricultural trauma resulting from machinery poses unique challenges due to severe injuries, delayed access to emergency care in rural areas, and complex extrication procedures. This case study describes the prehospital management and subsequent field amputation of a lower limb performed by Emergency Medical Technicians (EMTs).

pmc-13689197.title: Adapting the Fiscal Mapping Process to improve the financial sustainability of implementation support and mental health delivery organizations: protocol for a mixed methods study
pmc-13689197.creator: Margaret E. Crane, Alex R. Dopp, Aaron R. Lyon, Bo Kim, David C. Mohr, William A. Aldridge II, Joshua J. Kemp, A. Rani Elwy
pmc-13689197.description: BackgroundSustainability of evidence-based mental health intervention (EBI) implementation is a challenge to increasing access to mental health services. Funding is a common barrier to sustainment. EBIs, while cost effective, are expensive to implement. The Fiscal Mapping Process is a strategic planning tool designed for behavioral health agencies to plan the financial sustainment of specific EBIs.
